Miiks kun meeshaaleen kunneen seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu danda'u jedhanii yaaddoo qabu. Haa ta'u malee, mormiin isaanii qofaan gurgurtaa kana dhaabuuf aangoo seeraa guutuu akka hin qabne ibsameera.

title: 'African Biden': Somaliland president slammed for disastrous US interview
english: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi is facing heavy criticism following a poorly received appearance at the Hudson Institute in Washington. During the interview, he struggled to answer basic questions regarding trade deals and regional conflicts, leading observers to compare his performance to President Joe Biden. The incident has undermined his diplomatic efforts to gain official US recognition for Somaliland’s independence.
amharic: የሶማሊላንድ ፕሬዝዳንት አብዲራህማን መሐመድ አብዲላሂ በዋሽንግተን በተደረገ ውይይት ላይ ባሳዩት አሳሳቢ አፈጻጸም ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ነው። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ስለ ሀገሪቱ ማዕድን እና ስለ ቀጠናው ግጭቶች ለቀረቡላቸው ጥያቄዎች ግልጽ ምላሽ መስጠት ባለመቻላቸው፣ አድማጮች አፈጻጸማቸውን ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ጆ ባይደን ጋር በማነጻጸር ነቅፈዋቸዋል። ይህ ክስተት ሶማሊላንድ ከአሜሪካ እውቅና ለማግኘት የምታደርገውን ጥረት የሚያዳክም ሆኖ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Somaalilaand Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullaahii marii Waashingtonitti godhame irratti gaaffilee dhiyaataniif deebii quubsaa kennuu dadhabuun isaanii qeeqa cimaa hordofsiiseera. Pireezidaantichi waa'ee qabeenya biyyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa naannawaa irratti ibsa kennuuf rakkachuun isaanii, namoonni hedduu gocha isaanii kana Pireezidaant Jo Baayiden waliin wal bira qabanii qeeqa jiru. Taateen kun carraaqqii Somaalilaand mootummaa Ameerikaa biratti beekamtii argachuuf gootu irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessiseera.

title: More than 2,000 buildings damaged and at risk of collapse in Gaza
english: The Palestinian Ministry of Public Works and Housing has reported that over 2,000 structures in Gaza are severely damaged and face an imminent risk of falling. This warning follows a recent residential building collapse in Gaza City that claimed the lives of at least 21 individuals, including five children. Ongoing rescue operations are struggling to manage the critical humanitarian situation caused by these Israeli strikes.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የህዝብ ስራዎችና ቤቶች ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው በጋዛ ሰርጥ የሚገኙ ከ2,000 በላይ ህንጻዎች በደረሰባቸው ጉዳት ምክንያት የመውደቅ አደጋ ተጋርጦባቸዋል። በቅርቡ በጋዛ ከተማ አንድ የመኖሪያ ህንጻ በመውደቁ ምክንያት አምስት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ 21 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለስልጣናቱ በእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ሳቢያ ለተፈጠረው አስከፊ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ምላሽ ለመስጠት እና የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን ለመቀጠል እየጣሩ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Hojii Uummataa fi Mana jireenyaa kan Falasxiin akka ibsetti, gamoowwan Gaazaa keessa jiran kanneen 2,000 ol ta'an miidhaa guddaa irra ga'een gadi kufuu danda'u jedhamee sodaatamaa jira. Akkuma kanaan, dhiheenya kana magaalaa Gaazaatti gamoowwan jireenyaa tokko kufuun isaa ijoollee shan dabalatee namoonni 21 ol ta'an lubbuun darbuun isaanii beekameera. Hojiin lubbuu baraaruu fi haala kanaan walqabatee rakkoon namoomaa mudate irratti tattaaffiin taasifamaa jira.

title: US accuses Russia of trying to kill Ukrainian allies overseas
english: The US Department of Justice has charged five individuals linked to Russian intelligence for allegedly plotting to murder Ukrainian supporters and dissidents in the United States and abroad. Prosecutors claim the group recruited people to surveil targets and offered large payments to carry out these killings. The Kremlin has dismissed the accusations, demanding credible evidence before responding.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር ከሩሲያ የስለላ ድርጅቶች ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የተባሉ አምስት ግለሰቦች፣ በአሜሪካ እና በሌሎች ሀገራት የዩክሬን ደጋፊዎችን እና የሩሲያ ተቃዋሚዎችን ለመግደል ሲያሴሩ እንደነበር ክስ መሰረተባቸው። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ግድያዎችን ለመፈጸም ሰዎችን በመመልመል እና ገንዘብ በማቅረብ ሲንቀሳቀሱ እንደነበር የክስ ማመልከቻው ያሳያል። የሩሲያ መንግስት በበኩሉ፣ የተሰነዘረው ክስ እስካሁን ተጨባጭ ማስረጃ ያልቀረበበት በመሆኑ አስተያየት እንደማይሰጥ ገልጿል።
oromo: Manni maree haqaa Ameerikaa namoota shan qaamolee basaastota Raashiyaa waliin walitti dhufeenya qaban jedhaman irratti himata banera. Namoonni kunneen Ameerikaa fi biyyoota gara biraa keessatti namoota deggertoota Yuukreen ta'an ykn mormitoota Raashiyaa ta'an ajjeesuuf shiruu turan jedhamee himatamu. Himatamee kun akka ibsutti, namoonni kunneen ergamtoota kireeffachuudhaan fi kaffaltii guddaa waadaa galuudhaan ajjeechaa raawwachuuf yaalii godhaniiru; mootummaan Raashiyaa garuu himaticha dhugaa hin qabu jechuun haaleera.

title: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
english: Eight state leaders from Germany's CDU party have publicly supported Chancellor Friedrich Merz, arguing that the nation requires stability rather than leadership changes. Merz has been under significant pressure due to low approval ratings and the recent electoral success of the far-right AfD party. Despite rumors of a potential replacement, these premiers insist that the party must focus on policy action to regain public trust.
amharic: የጀርመን ሲዲዩ (CDU) ፓርቲ ስምንት የክልል መሪዎች ለቻንስለር ፍሬድሪክ ሜርዝ ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተዋል። መሪዎቹ አገሪቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት የሥልጣን ለውጥ ሳይሆን መረጋጋት እንደሚያስፈልጋት ገልጸዋል። ሜርዝ በዝቅተኛ ተወዳጅነት እና በጽንፈኛ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች የድምፅ እድገት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ቢሆኑም፣ መሪዎቹ ፓርቲው በሰው ጉዳይ ላይ ከማተኮር ይልቅ በአገራዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ እንዲያተኩር አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni sadarkaa naannoo saddeet kan paartii CDU jedhamu kan Jarmanii, Chanseleera biyyattii Friedrich Merz deggeruu isaanii ifa godhaniiru. Hoggantoonni kun biyyattiin jijjiirraa hoogganootaa osoo hin taane, tasgabbii fi nagaa barbaaddi jedhaniiru. Merz baay'ina deggeraa dhabuu fi dhiibbaa garee siyaasaa of-duraa (far-right) irraa kan ka'e rakkoo keessa kan jiran ta'us, hoggantoonni kun paartiin isaanii jijjiirraa namootaarratti osoo hin taane, hojii siyaasaarratti akka xiyyeeffatu gaafataniiru.

title: Ebola fight in DRC ‘far from over,’ warns WHO chief
english: The World Health Organization warns that the Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of Congo is far from finished, as cases continue to rise rapidly in the North Kivu province. While some regions are showing improvement, the emergence of the challenging Bundibugyo strain and the vast geographic spread of the virus are complicating control efforts. Health officials emphasize that the situation remains critical, with thousands of lives already lost to the outbreak.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ያለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ገና እንዳልተጠናቀቀ አስጠነቀቀ። በሰሜን ኪቩ ግዛት የበሽታው ስርጭት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ ሲሆን፣ አደገኛ የሆነው የቡንዲቡግዮ ቫይረስ ዝርያ መስፋፋት ለቁጥጥር ስራው ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል። ምንም እንኳን በአንዳንድ አካባቢዎች መሻሻሎች ቢታዩም፣ የቫይረሱ ስፋት እና ተለዋዋጭነት ሁኔታውን አሁንም አሳሳቢ እንዳደረገው ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa dhibee Ibolaatti biyya Koongoo keessatti mul'atu ammallee xumuramuuf akka hin geenye akeekkachiise. Godina Kaaba Kiivuu keessatti lakkoofsi namoota vaayrasichaan qabamanii saffisaan dabaluun isaa fi vaayrasichi akaakuu Bundibugyo jedhamuun babal'achuun isaa carraaqqii to'annoo irratti gufuu ta'eera. Bakkeewwan tokko tokko keessatti fooyya'iinsi kan mul'atu ta'us, bal'ina fi gosa vaayrasichaa kanaan kan ka'e haalli jiru ammas kan nama yaaddessu ta'uu ogeeyyoonni fayyaa ibsaniiru.

title: Sweden expels Iran embassy employee, citing security concerns
english: Sweden expels Iran embassy employee, citing security concerns

title: Ex-Trump ally Marjorie Taylor Greene says war on Iran must ‘stop’
english: Former Republican Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene has publicly criticized Donald Trump's military actions against Iran. She argues that the conflict is negatively impacting the economy, specifically causing a sharp rise in fuel costs. Greene, who previously supported Trump, has become an outspoken critic after their political fallout earlier this year.
amharic: ቀድሞ የሪፐብሊካን የፓርላማ አባል የነበሩት ማርጆሪ ቴይለር ግሪን፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ የከፈቱትን ጦርነት ተቃውመዋል። የዚህ ጦርነት መካሄድ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር በማድረግ በኢኮኖሚው ላይ አሉታዊ ተፅእኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም የትራምፕ ደጋፊ የነበሩት ግሪን፣ በሁለቱ መካከል በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ሳቢያ በአሁኑ ወቅት የትራምፕ ጠንካራ ተቺ ሆነዋል።
oromo: Miseensi kanaan duraa kan Paartii Rippiiblikaanii Maarjoorii Teeylar Giiriin, duula waraanaa Doonaald Traampii kan Iran irratti banan mormaniiru. Gaggeessuun waraana kanaa gatiin boba'aa akka dabalu gochuun diinagdee irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaa dubbataniiru. Giiriin kanaan dura deggartuu Traampii kan turan ta'us, erga wal-dhabanii booda amma akka ceepha'aa Traampii guddaatti ilaalamaa jiru.

title: Djibouti calls for assistance as thousands of Yemenis flee to country
english: Djibouti is urgently requesting international aid as thousands of Yemeni refugees arrive to escape escalating conflict. With over 2,500 arrivals recently and numbers expected to reach 10,000, the country says its current resources are completely overwhelmed. International organizations are currently providing emergency food and water but warn that more funding is required to sustain relief efforts.
amharic: በየመን እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ምክንያት በርካታ የየመን ዜጎች ወደ ጅቡቲ እየተሰደዱ በመሆኑ ሀገሪቱ አስቸኳይ ዓለም አቀፍ እርዳታ ጠይቃለች። ከባለፈው ሳምንት ጀምሮ ከ2,500 በላይ ሰዎች የገቡ ሲሆን ቁጥሩ ወደ 10,000 ሊደርስ እንደሚችል በመሰጋቱ የሀገሪቱ አቅም ተዳክሟል። ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት የምግብ እና የውሃ ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ቀውሱን ለመቋቋም ተጨማሪ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልግ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni waraanaa Yaman keessatti hammaachaa dhufuun lammiileen Yaman kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman gara Jibuutii godaanuun isaanii biyyattii gargaarsa hatattamaa akka gaafattu dirqisiiseera. Torban darbe keessa namoonni 2,500 ol kan seenan yoo ta'u, lakkoofsi kun gara 10,000tti ni dabala jedhamee waan eegamuuf dandeettiin biyyattii daangaa isaa darbeera. Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa midhaanifi bishaan dhiyeessaa kan jiran ta'us, rakkoo kana furuuf deeggarsi maallaqaa dabalataa akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli ‘double-tap’ air strike responsible for killing schoolboy in Gaza
english: An Israeli double-tap drone strike in Gaza City resulted in the deaths of a 15-year-old boy and a paramedic. The attack occurred when a second missile hit the site as bystanders were attempting to provide aid to the wounded, a tactic designed to maximize casualties. Despite a prior ceasefire agreement, this incident highlights ongoing lethal operations in the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የሁለትዮሽ የአየር ድብደባ አንድ የ15 ዓመት ታዳጊ እና አንድ የህክምና ባለሙያ ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የመጀመሪያው ድብደባ በደረሰበት ቦታ የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለመርዳት የሄዱትን ሰዎች በማነጣጠር ሁለተኛ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ነው። ምንም እንኳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን የቀጠለ ጥቃት ያሳያል።
oromo: Magalaa Gaazaa keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el ishee al lama walitti aansuun raawwatteen mucaa umriin isaa waggaa 15 fi ogeessa fayyaa tokko ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, namoonni miidhaman gargaaruuf yeroo bakka sana dhaqanitti xiyyaari lammaffaan yeroo deebi'ee rukututtiidha. Walii galtee dhaabbii waraana dura ture kan hin eegne ta'uu fi haleellaan kun naannichatti ammayyuu akka itti fufee jiru agarsiisa.

title: Gaza building collapse kills 21, including five children
english: A six-story apartment building in Gaza City collapsed overnight, resulting in the deaths of 21 people, including five children. The structure had been weakened by previous Israeli military strikes and was sheltering over 100 displaced individuals at the time. The collapse also damaged neighboring homes and tents in the Tal al-Hawa area.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በአንድ ባለ ስድስት ፎቅ ህንጻ ላይ በደረሰ መደርመስ 21 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አምስት ህፃናት ይገኙበታል። ህንጻው ቀደም ሲል በደረሰው የእስራኤል ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሲሆን፣ በአደጋው ወቅትም ከ100 በላይ ተፈናቃዮች ተጠልለውበት ነበር። የህንጻው መውደቅ በአካባቢው በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እና ድንኳኖች ላይም ጉዳት አድርሷል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti gamoon darbii jahaa ta'e tokko halkan keessa gadi jedhee diigamuun isaa lubbuun namoota 21 akka darbu taasiseera; isaan keessaas ijoolleen shan ni argamu. Gamoon kun miidhaa weerara Israa'el darbeen cimaa kan ture yoo ta'u, yeroo diigame kanatti namoonni buqqa'an 100 ol keessa jiraachaa turan. Diigamuu gamoichaatiin mannoota fi dunkaanonni naannichatti argamanis miidhamaniiru.

title: Israel trying to 'eliminate' living conditions for Palestinians in occupied West Bank, says report
english: A recent report by the rights group B'Tselem accuses Israel of systematically undermining Palestinian life in the West Bank through state-backed settler violence and restrictive policies. The document describes these actions as a deliberate project aimed at fragmenting Palestinian society and displacing them to ensure permanent Jewish-Israeli control over the territory. Consequently, Palestinians are being forced to choose between leaving, submitting to total control, or facing military violence.
amharic: ቢቲሴለም የተባለው የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድን ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት፣ እስራኤል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የፍልስጤማውያንን የኑሮ ሁኔታ ለማፍረስ ስልታዊ የሆነ ጥረት እያደረገች መሆኑን ከሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የፍልስጤማውያንን ማህበረሰብ ለመበተን እና በግዛቱ ላይ ዘላቂ የሆነ የእስራኤል ቁጥጥርን ለማረጋገጥ የታቀደ መሆኑን ሪፖርቱ ይገልጻል። በዚህም ምክንያት ፍልስጤማውያን ግዛቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ፣ ለሰፋሪዎች የበላይነት እንዲገዙ ወይም በወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንዲገደዱ ተደርገዋል።
oromo: Gareen mirga namoomaa B'Tselem jedhamu gabaasa haaraa baaseen, Israa'el naannoo West Bank keessatti jireenya Falasxiinotaa gadi qabuuf karoora sirnaa qabaachuushee himateera. Gochi kun hawaasa Falasxiin diiguufi biyyattii irratti to'annoo Israa'el yeroodhaaf osoo hin taane, dhaabbataan akka jiraatuuf kan karoorfame ta'uus gabaasichi ibsa. Haala kanaan, Falasxiinonni biyya gadhiisanii ba'uu, bulchiinsa Israa'eliif ajajamuu ykn humna waraanaatiin miidhamuu filachuuf dirqama jiru.

title: Trump picks anti-Islam, pro-Israel Republican Wesley Hunt as next ambassador to Saudi Arabia
english: President Donald Trump has nominated Republican Congressman Wesley Hunt to serve as the U.S. ambassador to Saudi Arabia. Hunt is a strong supporter of Israel and a military veteran who previously served as a diplomatic liaison in the kingdom. However, his nomination is controversial due to his history of making public remarks critical of Islam and Muslim societies.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካኑን የኮንግረስ አባል ዌስሊ ሃንትን የአሜሪካ የሳውዲ አረቢያ አምባሳደር አድርገው ሾሙ። ሃንት የእስራኤል ጠንካራ ደጋፊ እና የቀድሞ ወታደራዊ ዲፕሎማት ናቸው። ሆኖም በኢስላም እምነት እና በሙስሊም ማህበረሰቦች ላይ የሚሰነዝሩት የትችት ንግግሮች ይህንን ሹመት አከራካሪ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp miseensa Koongiresii Rippabilikaanootaa Weeslii Hant ambaasaaddara Ameerikaa kan Sa'udii Arabiyaa ta'anii akka hojjetan muudaniiru. Hant deeggartuu Israa'el kan ta'anii fi kanaan dura tajaajila dippilomaasummaa kan qabanidha. Ta'us, yaada isaan amantii Islaamaa fi hawaasa Muslimaa irratti kennan ka'umsa godhachuun muudamni isaanii mormii cimaa kaasuu danda'a.

title: US consumers will have to make 'short-term sacrifice' due to Iran war, says energy chief
english: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright stated that the ongoing conflict with Iran has disrupted global energy supplies, leading to temporary price hikes for American consumers. He explained that these difficulties are a necessary trade-off to curb Iran's long-term influence over oil costs. While he could not provide a specific timeline for price stabilization, he noted that current oil export levels from the Gulf have returned to pre-conflict amounts.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ ሚኒስትር ክሪስ ራይት እንደተናገሩት፣ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት የዓለምን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት በመረበሹ በአሜሪካ ሸማቾች ላይ ጊዜያዊ የዋጋ ጭማሪ አስከትሏል። ይህ የዋጋ ጭማሪ ኢራን በነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ ያላትን የረጅም ጊዜ ተፅዕኖ ለመቀነስ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የነዳጅ ዋጋ መቼ እንደሚረጋጋ እርግጠኛ መሆን ባይቻልም፣ ከባህረ ሰላጤው የሚወጣው የነዳጅ መጠን ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታው መመለሱን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Inarjii Ameerikaa Chris Wright akka ibsanitti, waraanni Iran waliin jiru dhiyeessii inarjii addunyaa waan gufachiiseef, gatiin boba'aa Ameerikaa keessatti yeroof dabaluu isaa ibsaniiru. Gatiin kun dabaluun isaa, Iran dhiibbaa gatii boba'aa irratti qabdu akka laafistuuf aarsaa yeroo gabaabaa kan gaafatu ta'uu eeraniiru. Gatiin boba'aa yoom akka tasgabbaa'u beekuu baatanis, baay'inni boba'aa Gulf keessaa gara gabaatti ba'aa jiru amma gara duratti deebi'uu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli shelling of Gaza City
english: Israeli military strikes in Gaza City's Tuffah neighborhood have resulted in one death and multiple injuries after a building was hit. Additionally, a man has died from injuries caused by previous attacks in the al-Jawazat area. Another individual remains in critical condition following an Israeli strike near al-Zawaida town.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ ቱፋ ሰፈር በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲገደል ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ጉዳት ደርሶበት የነበረ አንድ ወጣት ህይወቱ አልፏል። በሌላ በኩል በአል-ዛዋይዳ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ ሌላ ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ለሞት በሚያሰጋ ሁኔታ ተጎድቷል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel naannoo Tuffah kan magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa geggeesseen namni tokko yoo du'u, kanneen biroo baay'een madaa'aniiru. Kana malees, namni dargaggeessi tokko miidhaa guyyaa tokko dura isa ga'een lubbuun isaa darbeera. Haleellaa biraa magaalaa Al-Zawaayidaa cinaatti raawwatameenis namni tokko miidhaa hamaa irra ga'eera.

title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
english: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has expressed support for Canada to become the European Union's first associate member. This move aims to strengthen cooperation in sectors like technology, defense, and energy amid growing trade tensions between Canada and the United States. While no specific details on the membership process were provided, the proposal highlights a shared commitment to democratic values and strategic international collaboration.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ኮሚሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ኡርሱላ ቮን ደር ሌየን፣ ካናዳ የአውሮፓ ህብረት የመጀመሪያዋ ተባባሪ አባል እንድትሆን ሀሳብ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በካናዳ እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ባለው የንግድ አለመግባባት ወቅት በቴክኖሎጂ፣ በደህንነት እና በኢነርጂ ዘርፎች ያለውን ትብብር ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። የአባልነት ሂደቱ ዝርዝር ሁኔታ ባይገለጽም፣ ሀሳቡ ለዴሞክራሲያዊ እሴቶች እና ለስልታዊ ዓለም አቀፍ ትብብር ያላቸውን የጋራ ቁርጠኝነት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Komishinii Awurooppaa Ursula von der Leyen, biyyi Kanaadaa miseensa gargaartuu Gamtaa Awurooppaa kan jalqabaa akka taatu deeggarsa isanii ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo daldala biyyoota Kanaadaa fi Ameerikaa gidduutti cimaa dhufeen walqabatee, dameewwan teeknoolojii, ittisaa fi anniisaa keessatti walta'iinsa cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha. Haala miseensummaan itti raawwatamu irratti ibsi bal'aan kennamuu baatus, yaanni kun kabaja sirna dimokiraasii fi walta'iinsa istiraatejii idil-addunyaa irratti walii galuu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
english: Sam Altman, the CEO of OpenAI, recently acknowledged that public fears regarding the rapid development of artificial intelligence are reasonable. While he argued that people should rely on tech companies to act responsibly and safely, critics remain skeptical of the industry's ability to self-regulate. Meanwhile, US lawmakers have yet to establish formal rules for the technology, leaving the future of AI governance uncertain.
amharic: የOpenAI ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ሳም አልትማን የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት ወይም AI ቴክኖሎጂ እየፈጠረ ስላለው ፈጣን ለውጥ ህዝቡ ያለው ስጋት ተገቢ መሆኑን አምነዋል። የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ይህንን ስራ በሃላፊነት እንደሚወጡ ቢገልጹም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ኩባንያዎቹን ብቻውን መተው አደገኛ እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ። በአሜሪካ ደረጃም ቢሆን በቴክኖሎጂው ላይ ግልጽ የሆነ ህጋዊ ማዕቀፍ እስካሁን አለመዘጋጀቱ ሁኔታውን አሻሚ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hogganaan OpenAI Sam Altman, akkaataa teeknooloojiin 'AI' saffisaan itti guddatu irratti yaaddoon uummataa jiraatuun sirrii akka ta'e dubbateera. Inni dhaabbileen teeknooloojii kun itti gaafatamummaadhaan hojjechuuf fedhii qabu jedhee kan amanu ta'us, qeeqtoonni garuu ofiin of bulchuun isaanii ga'aa miti jedhu. Ammatti, mootummaan Ameerikaa seera ittiin AI to'atu baasuu irratti walii galtee irra waan hin geenyeef, rakkoon kun furmaata hatattamaa hin arganne.

title: At least 20 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
english: At least 20 people, including five children, were killed when a damaged six-story building collapsed in Gaza City’s Tal al-Hawa area. Many families had been living in the structurally unsound building because they had no other place to stay during the conflict. Rescue efforts are ongoing, though responders have struggled due to a severe lack of heavy equipment.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ ታላ አል-ሃዋ አካባቢ በጦርነት ጉዳት ደርሶበት የነበረ ባለ ስድስት ፎቅ ህንጻ በመፍረሱ ቢያንስ 20 ሰዎች መሞታቸው የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን ከሟቾቹ መካከል አምስቱ ህጻናት ናቸው። በግጭቱ ምክንያት ሌላ መጠለያ ያጡ በርካታ ቤተሰቦች ህንጻው ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ባይሆንም በውስጡ ይኖሩ ነበር። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የከባድ ማሽነሪዎች እጥረት ስላለባቸው በተገደበ አቅም ፍለጋውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaa naannoo Tal al-Hawaatti gamoon miidhaa waraanaan hir'atee ture tokko yeroo jigu, ijoollee shan dabalatee namoonni 20 ol ta'an lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Maatiin hedduun bakka biraa dhabuu irraan kan ka'e, gamoon kun miidhamee utuu jiruu fi sodaan akka jiru utuu beekanii keessa jiraachaa turan. Hojjettoonni gargaarsaa meeshaalee gurguddaa dhabuun rakkoo keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, hanga ammaa namoota baasuu fi lafarraa kaasuu irratti argamu.

title: Alex Eala firm on Asian Games participation despite threat of WTA fine
english: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala has committed to competing in the Asian Games even if it results in fines from the WTA for missing the mandatory China Open. Philippine officials fully support her decision to prioritize national representation over tour requirements. Furthermore, some lawmakers have pledged to cover any potential financial penalties she may incur for this choice.
amharic: የፊሊፒንስ የቴኒስ ኮከብ አሌክስ ኢላ፣ የግዴታ ውድድር የሆነውን የቻይና ኦፕንን በመዝለሏ የሴቶች የቴኒስ ማህበር (WTA) ቅጣት ቢጥልባትም፣ በእስያ ጨዋታዎች ላይ ለመሳተፍ ቆርጣለች። የፊሊፒንስ ባለስልጣናት ለሀገሯ ቅድሚያ በመስጠቷ ውሳኔዋን ሙሉ በሙሉ ይደግፋሉ። በተጨማሪም አንዳንድ የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት አባላት በውሳኔዋ ምክንያት ሊደርስባት የሚችለውን የገንዘብ ቅጣት ለመሸፈን ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Asteerti tenisii Filipinsii, Aleksi Ealaa, tapha Eeshiyaa irratti hirmaachuuf murteeffatteetti; kunis gabaa WTAn dorgommii Chaayinaa Open irratti argamuu dhabuu isheetiif adabbii irratti buusuu danda'uuf xiyyeeffannoo malee jechuudha. Aanga'oonni Filipinsii murtoo isheen biyya isheetiif dursa kennuuf goote kana guutummaatti deggeraniiru. Kana malees, miseensonni mana maree biyyattii tokko tokko adabbii maallaqaa ishee irra ga'uu danda'u hunda akka ishee kafaluuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Moment Kash Patel’s senate hearing takes bizarre turn
english: FBI Director Kash Patel faced significant scrutiny during a Senate hearing regarding recent changes to the agency's recruitment standards. His attempt to justify the relaxation of these hiring requirements surprised lawmakers from both major political parties. The session became notably contentious as officials expressed disbelief over his explanations.
amharic: የኤፍቢአይ ዳይሬክተር ካሽ ፓቴል በሴኔት ፊት ቀርበው በድርጅቱ የቀጠራ መስፈርቶች ላይ በተደረጉ ለውጦች ዙሪያ ማብራሪያ እንዲሰጡ ተደርገዋል። የቅጥር መስፈርቶቹን ለማላላት የወሰዱትን እርምጃ ለመከላከል ያደረጉት ሙከራ በሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ አባላት ዘንድ መደነቅን እና ጥርጣሬን ፈጥሯል። ይህ የሴኔት ስብሰባ በጉዳዩ ላይ በተነሳው አለመግባባት ምክንያት ያልተለመደ አቅጣጫ እንዲይዝ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Daayreektarri FBI Kaash Paatel qormaata qaama seentuun (Senate) qacarrii hojjettootaa irratti jijjiirama godhameef ibsa akka kennan dirqisiifamanii turan. Haala qacarrii kan laaffisan irratti ibsa kennuun isaanii miseensota paartilee siyaasaa lamaanii biratti dinqisiifannaa fi wal-dhabbii uumee jira. Taatee kanaan wal-qabatee mariin kun haala adda ta'een akka adeemsifamu ta'eera.

title: India summons Pakistani diplomat after incident in Arabian Sea
english: India has officially protested to Pakistan following a collision between the two nations' warships in the Arabian Sea. New Delhi claims the incident occurred in international waters due to Pakistan's unprofessional conduct, violating a 1991 bilateral safety agreement. India has demanded that both militaries adhere to established proximity rules to prevent future escalations.
amharic: በአረብ ባህር ውስጥ በሁለቱ ሀገራት የባህር ኃይል መርከቦች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት ህንድ በፓኪስታን ላይ ቅሬታ አቅርባለች። ህንድ የፓኪስታን የባህር ኃይል በአለም አቀፍ ውሀዎች ውስጥ የባለሙያነት ስሜት በጎደለው ተግባር የ1991ቱን የሁለትዮሽ ስምምነት እንደጣሰ ከሳለች። ህንድ ተመሳሳይ ግጭቶች እንዳይደገሙ ወታደራዊ አካላት የተስማሙባቸውን ህጎች እንዲያከብሩ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Indiyaan markaboota waraana biyyoota lamaanii galaana Arabaa keessatti walitti bu'uu isaanii hordofee Paakistaan irratti mormii dhageessisteerti. Niiw Deelhiin gochi kun kan raawwatame bishaan idil-addunyaa keessatti ta'uu fi waraanni Paakistaan qajeelfama ogeessummaa irraa fagaachuudhaan walii galtee bara 1991 cabsuu isaa himteetti. Indiyaan fuulduratti walitti bu'iinsi akkanaa akka hin uumamneef, gareen waraanaa lamaanuu seera tumame akka kabajan gaafatteerti.

title: Israeli double-tap strike kills 15-year-old and paramedic in Gaza
english: A 15-year-old boy in Gaza was killed by an Israeli double-tap airstrike while attempting to rescue an injured paramedic. This secondary attack occurred shortly after the initial strike, a tactic that claimed the lives of both the teenager and the medical responder. Since the 2025 ceasefire began, it is reported that an average of one child has been killed in Gaza every day.
amharic: በጋዛ አንድ የ15 ዓመት ታዳጊ ቆስሎ የነበረን የጤና ባለሙያ ለመርዳት በሄደበት ወቅት እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የሁለትዮሽ የአየር ጥቃት ተገድሏል። የመጀመሪያው ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ሰዎች ለመታደግ ሲመጡ ሁለተኛው ጥቃት መፈጸሙ ታዳጊውንና የጤና ባለሙያውን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። እ.ኤ.አ ከ2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በኋላ በጋዛ በየቀኑ በአማካይ አንድ ህፃን እየተገደለ እንደሚገኝ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti dargaggeessi umuriinsaa waggaa 15 ta’e, gargaarsa taasisuuf ogeessa fayyaa miidhamee ture bira yommuu ga’u, haleellaa qilleensa irraa kan Israa'el irratti taasisteen ajjeefameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yommuu namoonni gargaarsaaf itti deemanitti, haleellaa lammaffaa yeruma sana booda raawwatameen ta’uu gabaasameera. labsii dhaabbata waraanaa bara 2025 booda, Gaza keessatti guyyaa guyyaan daa’imni tokko ajjeefamaa akka jiru beekameera.

title: Real Madrid stars appear to hide Ceuta solidarity message
english: Three Real Madrid players were seen covering a message of support for the Spanish city of Ceuta on their shirts. The team wore these jerseys to show solidarity with the city following a large influx of migrants from Morocco. The players' actions during the display have sparked public attention regarding their intentions.
amharic: ሶስት የሪያል ማድሪድ ተጫዋቾች ለስፔኗ ሴኡታ ከተማ ድጋፍ የሚገልጽ ጽሁፍ በጀርሲያቸው ላይ ሲሸፍኑ ታይተዋል። ቡድኑ ከሞሮኮ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ስደተኞች ወደ ከተማዋ ከገቡ በኋላ አጋርነታቸውን ለማሳየት እነዚህን ማሊያዎች ለብሰው ነበር። የተጫዋቾቹ ድርጊት በህዝብ ዘንድ የተለያዩ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Taphattoonni Real Madrid sadii ergaa magaalattii Siiwutaaf deggarsa ibsu kan uffata isaanii irra ture dhoksuun mul'ataniiru. Gareen kun godaantonnii biyya Morooko irraa gara magaalattii sanaa erga heddumminaan dhufanii booda tokkummaa isaanii agarsiisuuf uffata kana uffatanii turan. Gochi taphattoota kanaa xiyyeeffannaa fi gaaffii uummata biratti kaaseera.

title: Senior minister says UK will 'no longer' stand by while 'innocent children are killed in Gaza'
english: British minister Louise Haigh has stated that the UK will take a more active stance against the ongoing violence in Gaza to protect Palestinian civilians. This follows the government's recent decision to impose an import ban on goods produced in illegal Israeli settlements. While the UK aims to build international support for a two-state solution, the Israeli embassy has criticized these measures as being one-sided.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ሚኒስትር ሉዊዝ ሄግ በጋዛ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን የሲቪል ተጎጂዎች ግድያ በመቃወም ብሪታንያ ዝም ብላ እንደማትመለከት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አቋም የመጣው መንግስት በህገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈሮች የሚመረቱ ምርቶች ላይ እገዳ ከጣለ በኋላ ነው። የብሪታንያ መንግስት የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄን ለመደገፍ ዓለም አቀፍ ጥረት እያደረገ ቢሆንም፣ የእስራኤል ኤምባሲ ግን እነዚህ ውሳኔዎች አድልዎ የተሞላባቸው ናቸው በማለት ተችቷል።
oromo: Ministirri biyya Ingiliz Luwiiz Heeg, hamma gaddisiisaa ta'e kan Gaza keessatti daa'imman irratti raawwatamaa jiru dhaabsisuuf mootummaan Ingiliz tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu dubbataniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufe erga mootummaan sun oomishaalee iddoowwan seeraan alaa Israa'elitti oomishaman biyyatti galchu dhorkee boodadha. Ingiliz furmaata biyya lamaa deeggaruuf yaalii gochaa jirtus, imbaasiin Israa'el murtee kana qabata tokko kan jettee mormiteetti.

title: Iran does not need to beat the Americans militarily. It just needs to outlast them
english: Iran is employing a strategy of long-term attrition rather than conventional warfare to challenge U.S. influence in the Middle East. By supporting Houthi forces in securing control over critical maritime passages like the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Iran is pressuring regional powers like Saudi Arabia to reconsider their alliances. Tehran believes it can achieve its objectives by outlasting American patience and disrupting global supply chains instead of engaging in direct military victory.
amharic: ኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ያላትን ተጽዕኖ ለመሞገት ወታደራዊ ድልን ከመቀዳጀት ይልቅ ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚዘልቅ የዛላ ስልት እየተጠቀመች ነው። በየመን የሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የባብ አል-መንደብን የባህር በር እንዲቆጣጠሩ በመደገፍ፣ እንደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ያሉ ሀገራት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እንዲመረምሩ ጫና እያደረገች ነው። የኢራን እቅድ በአሜሪካ ላይ ወታደራዊ የበላይነትን ከመቀዳጀት ይልቅ፣ የአሜሪካን ትዕግስት በመፈተን እና የአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮችን በማስተጓጎል የፖለቲካ ግቦቿን ማሳካት ነው።
oromo: Iraan dhiibbaa Ameerikaa naannichaa irratti qabdu dadhabsiisuuf, injifannoo waraanaa argachuu mannaa tarsiimoo dheeraa itti fufiinsa qabu fayyadamti. Humnoota Huutii Yemen keessa jiran gargaaruun daandii galaanaa barbaachisaa ta'e kan Bab el-Mandeb to'annoo isaanii jala akka galchan taasisuun, biyyoota akka Sa'udii Arabiyaa hidhata isaanii Ameerikaa wajjin akka qoratan dirqisiisutti jirti. Iraan kaayyoo ishee kan galmaan gahu, Ameerikaan danda'uu ishee akka dhabdu gochuudhaan fi dhiyeessii gabaa addunyaa jeequun, malee waraana kallattiidhaan injifachuun miti.

title: UK Lawyers for Israel calls to proscribe Doctors Without Borders as terror group
english: The advocacy group UK Lawyers for Israel has requested that the British government label the medical charity Doctors Without Borders (MSF) as a terrorist organization, citing alleged links between some of its staff and Palestinian militant groups. MSF has firmly rejected these claims, stating they conduct thorough vetting and that they were never alerted to any suspected misconduct until after the employees in question had been killed. The UK Charity Commission is currently reviewing the situation to determine if any official action is necessary.
amharic: UK Lawyers for Israel የተባለው ቡድን የህክምና እርዳታ ድርጅት የሆነው ‘ዶክተርስ ዊዛውት ቦርደርስ’ (MSF) ከአሸባሪ ቡድኖች ጋር ግንኙነት አለው በሚል በብሪታንያ መንግስት እንዲታገድ ጥያቄ አቅርቧል። ድርጅቱ በበኩሉ ክሱ ፈጽሞ መሰረተ-ቢስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ሰራተኞቻቸውን በጥንቃቄ እንደሚመርጡ እና ተጎጂዎቹ ከመሞታቸው በፊት ምንም አይነት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዳልደረሳቸው አስታውቋል። የብሪታንያ በጎ አድራጎት ኮሚሽን ጉዳዩን በማጣራት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gareen UK Lawyers for Israel jedhamu dhaabbata gargaarsa yaala fayyaa ‘Doctors Without Borders’ (MSF) jedhamu, hojjettoonni isaa garee hidhattoota Falasxiin waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu jechuun, mootummaan Britaniyaa akka isaan reebuu fi akka garee shororkeessaatti akka lakkaa’u gaafate. MSF himannaa kana guutummaatti kan haale yoo ta’u, hojjettoota isaanii qulqulleessanii akka ramadan fi namoonni himataman kun erga ajjeefamanii booda malee kanaan dura shakkii tokko illee akka hin qabaatin ibseera. Komishiniin Charity biyyattii dhimma kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Israeli officials leak details of secret US-Israel-Arab military meeting, says report
english: Military leaders from the United States, Israel, and several Arab nations recently held a secret meeting in Germany to discuss regional security amid the ongoing war with Iran. During the conference, U.S. Central Command reassured its partners that it would maintain its regional presence despite significant damage to American bases from Iranian attacks. The meeting also facilitated Israel’s formal move into the U.S. Central Command's area of responsibility, enabling closer military cooperation between Israel and its neighboring Arab countries.
amharic: የአሜሪካ፣ የእስራኤል እና የበርካታ የአረብ ሀገራት ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ከአይራን ጋር በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ዙሪያ ለመመካከር በጀርመን ሚስጥራዊ ስብሰባ አድርገዋል። በስብሰባው ወቅት የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ የኢራን ጥቃቶች በአሜሪካ መሠረቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ቢያደርሱም፣ የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች በክልሉ ያላቸውን መገኘት እንደማይቀንሱ አረጋግጠዋል። በተጨማሪም እስራኤል ወደ አሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ስልጣን ስር በመዛወሯ፣ ከአረብ ሀገራት ጋር በቀጥታ ወታደራዊ ትብብር የምታደርግበት መንገድ ተመቻችቷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi biyyoota Arabaa hedduu waraana weerara Iraniin walqabatee dubbachuuf biyya Jarmanitti walga'ii icciitii ta'e gaggeessaniiru. Walga'icharratti Ajajni Giddugaleessaa Ameerikaa (Centcom), miidhaan weerara Iraaniin buufataalee Ameerikaarratti ga'e jiraatus, humnootni isaanii naannichaa akka hin baane mirkaneessaniiru. Walga'ichi Israa'el seeraan gara aanga'aa Centcomtti akka makamtu kan godhe yoo ta'u, kunis biyyoota Arabaa fi Israa'el gidduutti walitti dhufeenya waraanaa cimaa uumuuf gargaara.

title: ICJP urges investigation into UK charity over support for illegal Israeli settlement
english: The International Centre of Justice for Palestinians has formally requested that the UK Charity Commission investigate the Gainsborough Trust for funding illegal Israeli settlements. The legal group argues that supporting these settlements violates both British law and the UK government's stance that the occupation is unlawful. This request follows reports that several British charities have funneled millions of pounds into these settlements over the past few years.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፍ የፍልስጤማውያን ፍትህ ማዕከል (ICJP) የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በጎ አድራጎት ድርጅቶች ኮሚሽን 'ጌይንስቦሮ ትረስት' የተባለ ድርጅት በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረገ መሆኑን እንዲመረምር ጠይቋል። የሕግ ቡድኑ ድጋፉ የብሪታንያ ሕግን የሚጥስ እና የእስራኤልን ወረራ ሕገ-ወጥ ነው ከሚለው የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግሥት አቋም ጋር የሚቃረን መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ ጥያቄ የቀረበው የተለያዩ የብሪታንያ በጎ አድራጎት ድርጅቶች ባለፉት ጥቂት ዓመታት ውስጥ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ፓውንድ ወደ እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች መላካቸውን የሚጠቁሙ ዘገባዎች መውጣታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Wiirtuun Idil-addunyaa Mirga Namoomaa Palastinii (ICJP) Komishiniin Charity UK 'Gainsborough Trust' jedhamu kanneen buufataalee Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'an deeggaraa jiru akka qoratu gaafate. Gareen kun deeggarsi kun seera biyyattii fi ejjennoo mootummaan UK waraansa Israa'el seeraan alaa dha jedhu kan cabsu ta'uu ibse. Gaaffiin kun kan dhufe, dhaabbileen gargaarsaa UK tokko tokko waggoota darban keessa miiliyoonaan lakkaa'amu gara buufataalee kanneenitti erguu isaanii gabaasni ifa erga godhee booda.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: Tigrayan nationalism has successfully defended the people's survival but has failed to transition from wartime mobilization to a stable, citizen-led political order. The current crisis is rooted in the leadership's tendency to mistake military control and survival for a legitimate, long-term governing system. To move forward, Tigray must evolve beyond its history of conflict and establish durable institutions where power is governed by law rather than by individual factions.
amharic: የትግራይ ብሔርተኝነት የህዝቡን ህልውና ለማስጠበቅ ቢችልም፣ ከጦርነት ግብአት ወደ የተረጋጋ እና ህዝባዊ የፖለቲካ ስርዓት ለመሸጋገር አልቻለም። አሁን ያለው ቀውስ የመጣው የፖለቲካ አመራሩ ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥርን እና የቡድን ህልውናን እንደ ትክክለኛ የረጅም ጊዜ አስተዳደር በመቁጠራቸው ነው። ትግራይ ከዚህ የጦርነት ታሪክ በመውጣት ስልጣን በግለሰቦች ወይም በቡድኖች ሳይሆን በህግ የሚመራባቸው ጠንካራ ተቋማትን መገንባት ይኖርባታል።
oromo: Sabboonummaan Tigraay jiraachuu ummataa tiksuu danda'us, mooraa waraanaarraa gara sirna siyaasaa tasgabbaa'aa fi ummataan gaggeeffamutti ce'uu hin dandeenye. Rakkoon ammaa kun kan maddetti hoggantoonni to'annoo waraanaa fi jiraachuu isaanii akka sirna bulchiinsaatti ilaaluu isaaniiti. Tigraay gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuuf, seenaa waraanaa kana keessaa baatee, aangoon namoota ykn garee harkatti osoo hin taane seeraan kan gaggeeffamu dhaabbilee cimaa ijaaruun barbaachisaadha.

title: US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination
english: The US government has imposed visa restrictions on South African officials suspected of discriminating against the country's white minority. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated these measures target those involved in land seizure policies or rhetoric that incites racial tensions. While the Trump administration claims these policies are discriminatory, the South African government denies these accusations and maintains that its land laws are legal and balanced.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት በደቡብ አፍሪካ ነጭ ዘር ያላቸው ዜጎች ላይ መድልዎ ፈጽመዋል ባሏቸው የመንግሥት ባለሥልጣናት ላይ የቪዛ ገደብ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ እንደተናገሩት፣ ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በንብረት ወረራ እና ዘረኝነትን በሚያባብሱ ድርጊቶች ላይ ነው። የደቡብ አፍሪካ መንግሥት በበኩሉ እነዚህን ክሶች ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የመሬት ይዞታ ሕጎቹ ሕገ-መንግሥታዊ እና ፍትሐዊ መሆናቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hoggantoota biyya Afrikaa Kibbaa gosa adiirratti loogii raawwatan jedhamanirratti daangaa viizaa kaa’eera. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarsoo Ruubiyoon akka jedhanitti, tarkiinichi kan fudhatame siyaasa lafa fudhachuu fi walitti bu’iinsa sanyummaa kakaasuun walqabatee dha. Mootummaan Afrikaa Kibbaa garuu himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta’u, seerawwan lafa isaa kan haqa qabeessa ta’uu fi mirga namoomaa kan kabajan ta’uu ibseera.

title: Manchester derby VAR error caused by ‘tunnel vision’: Pro Ref chief Webb
english: The head of refereeing, Howard Webb, admitted that a VAR error led to an incorrect goal being awarded to Erling Haaland during the Manchester derby. Officials became too focused on Haaland's position and failed to notice that his teammate, Enzo Fernandez, was actually offside and involved in the play. As a result, the two officials responsible for the error have been suspended from duty until after the upcoming international break.
amharic: የዳኞች ዋና ሃላፊ ሃዋርድ ዌብ በማንቸስተር ደርቢ ጨዋታ ወቅት በVAR ስህተት ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ የተሳሳተ ግብ ማስቆጠሩን አምነዋል። የዳኞች ቡድን በሃላንድ አቋቋም ላይ ብቻ በማተኮራቸው ኢንዞ ፈርናንዴዝ ከጨዋታ ውጪ በሆነ ቦታ ላይ ሆኖ በጨዋታው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ማሳረፉን ሳይገነዘቡ ቀርተዋል። በዚህ ስህተት ምክንያት ለጉዳዩ ተጠያቂ የሆኑት ሁለት የVAR ዳኞች ከአለም አቀፍ ጨዋታዎች እረፍት በኋላ እስኪመለሱ ድረስ ታግደዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan abbootii seeraa kubbaa miillaa Ingiliz Howard Webb, tapha Manchester derby irratti Erling Haaland goolii dogoggoraan akka galche VAR dogoggoreera jedhe. Abbootiin seeraa xiyyeeffannaa isaanii Haaland irratti qofa gochuun, taphataan isaa Enzo Fernandez iddoo seeraan ala ta'e irra ta'ee taphicha irratti dhiibbaa uumaa akka ture hubachuu dadhabaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, abbootiin seeraa VAR lamaan dogoggora kana uuman hanga boqonnaa taphoota idil-addunyaa boodaatti hojii irraa dhorkamaniiru.

title: US House votes to end Iran war, 7 Republicans join in favour
english: The U.S. House of Representatives recently passed a war powers resolution to stop President Trump from continuing military actions in Iran without formal congressional authorization. The measure gained bipartisan support, with seven Republicans joining Democrats, although it is expected to face a presidential veto. Lawmakers are moving toward the upcoming midterm elections as the costly conflict continues to impact the U.S. economy and military resources.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ያለ ምክር ቤቱ ፈቃድ በኢራን የሚያደርጉትን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲያቆሙ የሚያስገድድ የጦር ስልጣን ውሳኔ አሳለፈ። ውሳኔው ሰባት ሪፐብሊካኖችን ጨምሮ የሁለቱን ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ ያገኘ ቢሆንም፣ በፕሬዝዳንቱ የቪቶ መብት ሊታገድ እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል። አገሪቱ ወደ መካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ እየተቃረበች ባለችበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ ውድ የሆነው ይህ ጦርነት በአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ እና ወታደራዊ አቅም ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree bakka buutota Ameerikaa keessatti, pirezidaanti Traamp hayyama mana maree malee Iran irratti waraana itti fufuu akka hin dandeenye kan ittisu murteen tokko dabreera. Murteen kun miseensota paartii Riippaabilikaanii torba kan dabalatu ta'us, pirezidaantichi ofii isaanii veto gochuun ni dhaabanii jedhamee eegama. Biyyattiin gara filannoo giddu-galeessatti adeemaa jirtutti, waraanni baasii olaanaa gaafatu kun diinagdee fi humna waraana Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumaa jira.

title: Seoul court orders North Korea to pay $32.5m for blowing up office
english: A South Korean court has ordered North Korea to pay approximately $32.5 million in damages for the 2020 destruction of a joint liaison office. The building, located in the Kaesong Industrial Complex, was demolished by Pyongyang during a period of heightened diplomatic tension. Although this marks a historic legal challenge by Seoul, experts believe it is highly improbable that North Korea will comply with the ruling.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ፍርድ ቤት ሰሜን ኮሪያ እ.ኤ.አ በ2020 በካሶንግ ከተማ ያፈረሰችውን የጋራ የትስስር ቢሮ ካሳ እንድትከፍል ወስኗል። ሰሜን ኮሪያ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረት ወቅት ያፈረሰችውን ህንጻ በተመለከተ፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ የ32.5 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ካሳ እንዲከፈል ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፏል። ይህ በደቡብ ኮሪያ በኩል በሰሜን ኮሪያ ላይ የቀረበ የመጀመሪያው የካሳ ጥያቄ ቢሆንም፣ የሰሜን ኮሪያ መንግስት ክፍያውን ይፈጽማል ተብሎ አይጠበቅም።
oromo: Mana murtii Kibba Koriyaatti mootummaan Kaaba Koriyaa dhaabbata waliin hojjetu kan bara 2020 diigeef beenyaa doolaara miiliyoona 32.5 akka kaffalu murteesseera. Ijaarsichi magaalaa Kaesongitti kan argamu yoo ta'u, yeroo walitti bu'iinsi siyaasaa cimaa turetti Kaaba Koriyaan diigame. Kunis kan jalqabaa yoo ta'u, garuu Kaaba Koriyaan murtoo kana fudhattee beenyaa kaffaluun ishee akka hin oolle ogeeyyonni ni amanu.

title: What’s the Pinglu Canal, China’s new gateway to Southeast Asia?
english: China has officially opened the Pinglu Canal, a major infrastructure project designed to link inland southwestern provinces directly to the sea. By creating a shorter route to Southeast Asian markets, the canal is expected to lower logistics costs by up to 30 percent and significantly reduce shipping distances. This initiative is a key component of the broader Belt and Road strategy, aiming to boost both domestic industrial growth and international trade efficiency.
amharic: ቻይና በደቡብ ምዕራብ የሚገኙ የውስጥ አውራጃዎችን በቀጥታ ከባህር ጋር የሚያገናኝ የፒንግሉ ቦይ የተሰኘ ትልቅ የመሰረተ ልማት ፕሮጀክት በይፋ ከፍታለች። ይህ ቦይ ወደ ደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ ገበያዎች የሚያደርሰውን የጉዞ ርቀት በማሳጠር የሎጂስቲክስ ወጪን እስከ 30 በመቶ እንደሚቀንስ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት የቻይና የ'ቤልት ኤንድ ሮድ' ስትራቴጂ አካል ሲሆን፣ የአገር ውስጥ የኢንዱስትሪ እድገትን እና የአለም አቀፍ ንግድ ቅልጥፍናን ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Chaayinaan bulchiinsota keessoo biyyattii gama kibba-lixaa qajeelatti garba waliin wal-quunnisiisuuf pirojektii guddaa kan ta'e 'Pinglu Canal' jedhamu banatteetti. Daandiin bishaanii kun gabaa Eeshiyaa kibba-bahaa gahuuf karaa gabaabaa uumuun, baasii geejjibaa harka 30 gadi hir'isuuf akka gargaaru eegama. Pirojektichi tarsiimoo 'Belt and Road' Chaayinaa keessaa kan maddan yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas guddina indastirii biyya keessaa fi bu'a qabeessummaa daldala idil-addunyaa foyyeessuu dha.

title: Republican forces Congress to hold impeachment vote for Pete Hegseth
english: US Representative Thomas Massie is compelling a formal congressional vote to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. This legislative move is driven by opposition to the ongoing American military conflict involving Iran. The push comes amid public sentiment showing that a significant majority of Americans do not support the current war effort.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አባል ቶማስ ማሲ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በስልጣን ላይ ለማንሳት ወይም በኢምፒችመንት ለመክሰስ ምክር ቤቱ ድምጽ እንዲሰጥ እያስገደዱ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በመቃወም ነው። አብዛኛው የአሜሪካ ህዝብ በጦርነቱ እንደማይደግፍ በተለያዩ የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች መረጋገጡ ለዚህ እርምጃ እንደ ምክንያት ተነስቷል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree bakka bu’oota ummataa Ameerikaa kan ta’an Thomas Massie, ministira ittisa biyyattii Pete Hegseth irratti tarkaanfii ariitii (impeachment) fudhachuuf mana mareen sagalee akka kennu dirqisiisaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraana Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru mormuufi. Qorannoon tokko akka ibsutti, lammiileen Ameerikaa baay’een waraana kana akka hin deggerre mul’iseera.

title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts drone headed for Mecca
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully destroyed a drone launched by Houthi rebels that was headed toward the holy city of Mecca. Although the coalition considers the security of these sacred sites a non-negotiable priority, the Houthi group has officially denied any involvement in targeting religious areas. This incident highlights a dangerous rise in regional tensions following recent escalations in the long-standing conflict.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያን የሚመራው ጥምረት ወደ መካ ከተማ የተላከ የሁቲ አማጽያን ድሮን በአየር ላይ መትቶ ጥሏል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት የቅዱስ ከተማዋን ደህንነት እንደ ቀይ መስመር ቢገልጹም፣ የሁቲ ቡድን ግን በቅዱስ ቦታዎች ላይ ጥቃት እንዳልሰነዘረ አስተባብሏል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭት በድጋሚ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mootummoota gamtoomaniin kan durfamu gareen Saudii, xiyyaarri malee kan Houthiin gara magaala qulqulluu Makkaatti ergame qilleensa irratti barbadeessaniiru. Saudiin nageenyi magaala kanaa daangaa kan hin darbamne ta’uu ibsituus, gareen Houthii garuu iddoowwan amantii irratti akka hin xiyyeeffanne dubbachuun olola kana haaleera. Taatee kun waldhabdee yeroo dheeraa ture kan amma bifa haaraan dabalataa dhufe ta’uu argisiisa.
